## Receiver architecture

- Main tasks of a GNSS receiver:
  - **Acquire** signals from at least four satellites
  - **Track** the signals to maintain lock and extract measurements
  - **Demodulate** the navigation message to obtain ephemeris and clock data
  - **Compute** the receiver position and clock bias using the measurements

### Architecture overview

![](assets/figures/gnss_receiver_detailed.svg){align="center"}

### Architecture implementation

- The final implementation of this architecture is not unique, may depend on:
  - Number of bands / frequencies supported
  - Number of constellations supported
  - Number of channels (parallel tracking loops)
  - Receiver type (software-defined, hardware-defined, ...)
  - Cost driven or performance driven design
  - Portable device or fixed installation

### Design drivers

- *Low power consumption*, i.e. long operational time (for instance
around 4 hours of continuous operation using external batteries)
- *Reduced \acr{TTFF}*, the receiver should be able to acquire and track the signals and compute a position as soon as possible.
- *High accuracy* some applications require very accurate (e.g. cm) positioning.
- *High acquisition sensitivity*, the receiver should be able to acquire signals even in challenging environments (e.g. low $C/N_0$).
- *High tracking sensitivity*, the receiver should be able to track signals even with low $C/N_0$

### Receiver types

::: {.receiver-types}
| Category | Main characteristics | 🔋 | ⏱️ | 🎯 | 🔎 | 📡 | Cost |
|----------|---------------------|----|----|----|----|----|------|
| Consumer</br>mass-market | Single freq., single-constellation,</br>Low cost, small size, limited performance | $\color{green}{\downarrow}$ | $\color{green}{\downarrow}$ | $\color{green}{\downarrow}$ | $\color{green}{\downarrow}$ | $\color{green}{\downarrow}$ | 10-100 € |
| Professional | Single or multi-constellation,</br>High performance (incl. automotive) | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | $\color{green}{\downarrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | 100-2000 € |
| Safety-of-life | Multi-constellation</br>High performance, High reliability | $\color{green}{\downarrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | 1000-5000 € |
| Research</br>survey, geodesy | Multi-constellation</br>High performance, High reliability, High accuracy | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | $\color{red}{\uparrow}$ | 5000-10000 € |

[**Legend:** 🔋 Power consumption · ⏱️ Time to first fix (TTFF) · 🎯 Accuracy · 🔎 Acquisition sensitivity · 📡 Tracking sensitivity]{style="font-size: 0.8em;"}

[Arrows indicate relative level ($\color{red}{\uparrow}$ higher, $\color{green}{\downarrow}$ lower)]{style="font-size: 0.8em;"}
:::
